graph.name: Amagi Cloud Playout Architecture for Linear Broadcast
graph.notes: Amagi leverages AWS compute, storage, and networking to power over 400 linear broadcast TV channels with active-active hitless redundancy across availability zones.

nodes.name: Venue / Camera
nodes.notes: Live event venue capturing camera feeds (e.g. sporting events, news, shows)

nodes.name: CLOUDPORT LIVE
nodes.notes: Kubernetes cluster on AWS receiving live feeds via Zixi, SRT, or Direct Connect

nodes.name: AUTOMATION
nodes.notes: EC2 cluster running channel scheduling and automation management

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Amazon S3 storing graphics, VOD files, and closed captioning assets

nodes.name: ASSET PROCESSING
nodes.notes: EC2 engine rendering graphic overlays, tickers, and lower-thirds

nodes.name: PLAYOUT
nodes.notes: CPU-only EC2 compute running the main cloud playout engine

nodes.name: HITLESS SWITCHER
nodes.notes: Primary Hitless Switcher handling seamless stream switching

nodes.name: HITLESS (Secondary AZ)
nodes.notes: Redundant Hitless Switcher deployed in a separate Availability Zone for high availability

nodes.name: DIRECT CONNECT
nodes.notes: AWS Direct Connect dedicated connection to deliver linear feeds

nodes.name: Head End
nodes.notes: Broadcast satellite/cable head end receiving linear stream

edges.notes: Camera sends live stream feed via Zixi/SRT/Direct Connect into CloudPort Live
CloudPort Live streams live event video feed to Playout
Automation service triggers playout schedule for broadcast
Asset processing fetches graphics, captions, and VOD files from S3
Asset Processing applies graphics and overlays to the active playout stream
Playout streams output to primary Hitless Switcher
Playout streams output concurrently to redundant Hitless Switcher in secondary AZ
Primary stream routed into Direct Connect link
Secondary AZ stream routed into Direct Connect for zero-frame loss redundancy
Direct Connect delivers linear broadcast feed directly to Head End
